summary: The session discusses the importance of external data in enhancing AI outcomes and predictive analytics. It highlights how integrating various types of external data, such as weather, social media, and IoT data, can significantly improve business forecasts and decision-making. Real-world examples illustrate the unexpected relationships between different data types and their impact on business performance.

key_points: External data can significantly influence business outcomes.
85% of data affecting outcomes comes from outside organizations.
Unstructured data comprises 80-90% of new data on the internet.
Examples include social media, weather data, and IoT sensor data.
External data can enhance demand forecasting accuracy.
Innovative uses of data include monitoring retail foot traffic and satellite imagery.
Quality of external data can vary significantly.
Ethical and regulatory considerations are crucial when using external data.
APIs and batch ingestion are common methods for data integration.
Data marketplaces provide vetted sources for external data.
Start with clear business outcomes to guide data integration.
Prioritize high-signal enrichment over breadth in data collection.

key_takeaways: Integrating external data can lead to significant improvements in predictive analytics and business outcomes.
Understanding the quality and source of external data is crucial for ethical and effective use.
Utilizing data marketplaces can streamline the acquisition of high-quality external data.
